pricing.billing_basis: duration of audio streamed, including silence and retries; rate-dependent estimate, not an invoice; the page lists one Live rate and names no model tiers

protocol_caveat: session.update requests zoom-scribe-en-pro-v2.1 inside config.model, the only placement live mode honors (a top-level model, a query parameter, transcription.model and session.model are silently ignored); the server reports the model in session.updated, and a different echo fails the attempt. The model is not in the published live-mode reference. Zoom segments speech with its own voice activity detection and sends one final transcript per segment, with no partials. input_audio_buffer.commit at speech end is not in the published live-mode reference but is honored: it ends the open segment at the commit point. A commit with no open segment produces no event, so there is no finalize acknowledgment; completion is session.closed after session.close, which flushes every open segment. The documented default limit is 20 concurrent sessions.
